svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank: top 464.4 x 264.4 mm with a 16 mm skirt folded down on all sides;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: relieve the corners, they need not be closed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven exhaust slots 6 x 85 mm, 14 mm apart, the first 32.2 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left edge, from 162.2 to 247.2 back from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle bolt holes 5.5 mm on the centre line, 127.2, 157.2, 307.2 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw holes 4.5 mm in the front and back skirts, 82.2, 232.2 and 382.2

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the left edge, 7.8 above the skirt's lower edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the top rests on the wall tops; the skirt hangs outside the walls

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 1 mm gap, where the rivet nut flanges sit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six M4 pan-head screws through the skirt into the rivet nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid drops on without forcing and every hole lines up.
